# m.snapshots

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The current state of tickers of any asset classes, from Massive's unified snapshot.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.snapshots(symbols, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`
- `poll(interval, mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `Symbol`, `LastUpdated`, `LastQuoteLastUpdated` and `LastTradeLastUpdated`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Massive's exact tickers of any class (`AAPL`, `O:SPY251219C00600000`, `C:EURUSD`, `X:BTCUSD`, `I:SPX`), or a table; a ticker without a prefix is a stock. `dm.ALL` is refused: use a class's `snapshots(dm.ALL)`. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by (`"ticker"`); past 250 tickers it orders each request's rows, not all of them. |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The sort direction, per request the same way. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The total-row cap. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters; `type` is refused, since Massive rejects it beside tickers. Keys: `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`, `type`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Unified Snapshot (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |
| Indices Basic | Not included |
| Indices Starter | 15-minute delayed |
| Indices Advanced | Real-time |
| Indices Business | Real-time |
| Options Basic | Not included |
| Options Starter | 15-minute delayed |
| Options Developer | 15-minute delayed |
| Options Advanced | Real-time |
| Options Business | Real-time |
| Stocks Basic | Not included |
| Stocks Starter | 15-minute delayed |
| Stocks Developer | 15-minute delayed |
| Stocks Advanced | Real-time |
| Stocks Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset." |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. Null on a row of any other class. |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Value` | double | Value of Index. |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". From the `details` object: The details for this contract. |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | String | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). |
| `Error` | String | The error while looking for this ticker. |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair Market Value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). |
| `GreeksDelta` | double | The change in the option's price per $0.01 increment in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. |
| `GreeksGamma` | double | The change in delta per $0.01 change in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. |
| `GreeksTheta` | double | The change in the option's price per day. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. |
| `GreeksVega` | double | The change in the option's price per 1% increment in volatility. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. |

| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest value for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest value for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. |

| `SessionPrice` | double | The price of the most recent trade or bid price for this asset. From the `session` object: Comprehensive trading session metrics, detailing price changes, trading volume, and key price points (open, close, high, low) for the asset within the current trading day. Includes specific changes during early, regular, and late trading periods to enable detailed performance analysis and trend tracking. Values describe the current trading session only; nothing carries over from the previous session apart from `previous_close`. For stocks snapshots, an asset that has not traded yet this session reports `volume: 0` with the price and change fields omitted rather than reported as 0. During early trading on stocks snapshots, `volume` and `price` track the session as it happens, but `open`, `high`, `low`, `close` and `vwap` are omitted until the regular session opens, as those report official session prices. They appear from the open and remain through late trading. |

| `Underlying` | String | The instrument Massive links the row to, in the library's canonical symbol form; for an option, the linked instrument, not what the contract delivers. From REST `underlying_asset.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the contract's underlying asset. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan." |
| `UnderlyingAssetTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. |
| `Type` | String | The asset class for this ticker. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
